# Code Simplicity Review

Use this to keep implementation minimal and readable.

Check:

- Every abstraction has a current need.
- Complex conditionals, nested logic, and clever code can be simplified.
- Duplicate or defensive code adds real value.
- Feature flags, generic helpers, interfaces, and extension points are not
  speculative.
- Names and structure make the common path obvious.

Prefer targeted simplification recommendations that preserve behavior and
reduce maintenance cost.
